Observation completeness remains an explicit gate: unproven or unassigned candidates block the motor; order-level observations block final preview until a proven renderer channel exists.
Only minimum operational fields are copied; raw payload, customer, phone, address, payment and unrelated PII are not retained.
PR #11 remains draft and not merged.
Observation scope revalidation: DSOBSDESCIT, DSOBSPEDDIGCMD and TXPRODCOMVEN are item-level candidates; DSOBSCOMANDA is order-level in the official delivery report path.

A Windows Integrated Authentication SQL preflight is prepared; it does not read Odhen credentials or order tables and only allows the next gate if the current Windows principal has SELECT and no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/EXECUTE/ALTER/CONTROL permission.

The SQL preflight was hardened after Claude identified a real gap: database-level permission checks alone do not prove table-level read-only access. V2 now resolves the exact target objects, requires SELECT on each, blocks object/schema/database write capability, blocks elevated roles, and checks column-level UPDATE.

SQL preflight V3 closes the two review gaps from Claude: permission metadata returning NULL is now UNKNOWN/blocking rather than false, and any executable stored procedure blocks the claim that the Windows principal is strictly read-only.

A zero-change metadata-only principal inventory has been added. It does not impersonate users and does not read operational tables; it hashes principal names and only triages obvious write roles/permissions, broad db_datareader candidates, and candidates needing DBA confirmation.
A static verifier guards the inventory script against operational-table access, impersonation, permission mutation, data mutation and environment.xml access.

The metadata-only principal inventory static gate was independently replayed from the GitHub branch content and PASSed with zero forbidden operational objects, impersonation, security mutation, data mutation or environment.xml references.

CAIXA_MOOCA code/config inspection identified a passive print-log route: with salvaLogDetalhadoIMP enabled, printCommands writes the complete print command text immediately before the official printer path.
The passive log route requires no SQL Server access and no Odhen/Teknisa code modification for the preferred design.

The delivery report print text is known by code to contain NRCOMANDA, items/quantities, merged item observations from DSOBSDESCIT/DSOBSPEDDIGCMD and order-level DSOBSCOMANDA; NRVENDAREST and TXPRODCOMVEN are absent from this source.
Raw print text may contain customer/address/payment PII; any reader must sanitize in memory and must not persist or transmit raw text.
Passive print-log preparation now includes a pure projection parser that is allowlist-only: unrecognized lines, including PII/payment/address text, are never copied into the returned projection.

Passive print parser profiles are explicitly proof-scoped. SYNTHETIC_ONLY profiles can exercise parsing but cannot become ready_for_live_shadow; live readiness requires REAL_SAMPLE_PROVEN plus proven full-block framing.

A pure passive-tail planner now baselines at current EOF and refuses to replay historical log content. It distinguishes append, no-change, rotation/replacement, truncation and missing source without touching the filesystem.

Synthetic verification coverage was added for PII non-leakage, print-source observation contract, SQL-normalizer blocking before real profile proof, append-only cursor behavior, rotation/truncation handling and zero print/source-write effects.
Synthetic passive-log modules were compiled with strict TypeScript and executed in an independent Node 22.16.0 / TypeScript 5.8.3 harness; result: passive-print-log-v132: ok.
The passive projection dedupe fingerprint now hashes only the sanitized operational projection, so changes limited to known structural PII do not change the operational fingerprint.
The tail planner now refuses append reads when strong file identity is not proven; path equality alone cannot authorize an append read after possible rotation/replacement.
Privacy wording was hardened: structural customer/phone/address/payment fields are excluded, but free-text observations are explicitly treated as potentially sensitive rather than claimed PII-free.
Adversarial passive-parser hardening now blocks a framed block containing multiple printed order IDs, preventing accidental cross-order contamination.
Once an order-level OBS. footer is recognized, current item association is cleared so later item-style observation lines cannot silently attach back to the previous item.
The hardened passive suite was recompiled and rerun after privacy, file-identity and framing changes; result remained passive-print-log-v132: ok.
CAIXA_MOOCA real IMP log source was manually metadata-proven on 2026-09-29: C:\TEKNISA\odhen-perifericos\Log\092026\2026_09_29_IMP.txt exists.
Baseline EOF for the one-order passive proof is 352273 bytes; LastWriteTime was 2026-09-29 13:49:19 local and CreationTime was 2026-09-29 12:03:07 local.
No log content was read to establish this baseline; only file metadata was read manually outside Claude Code.
The generic 2026_09_29_IMP.txt grew from 352273 to 369760 bytes while César confirmed no delivery order had printed, proving that file growth alone is not a delivery-order signal.
After a later non-isolated delivery batch, metadata was re-read at Length 386151 and LastWriteTime 2026-09-29 14:14:53 local; this is a post-batch reference point, not a one-order proof.

Because the generic IMP log contains other print traffic, any real one-order proof must correlate a bounded append interval with an isolated natural delivery print; raw size growth by itself is insufficient.

Human routing truth for production was captured on 2026-09-30: lunch is concentrated in the dining-room sushi printers; dinner routes Combinados to DELIVERY SUSHI 1, Enrolados to DELIVERY SUSHI 2, and Enrolados Quentes to BALCAO SUSHI 2; Caixa and Cozinha remain on their named destinations.

Every production ticket now has a content contract requiring the same TATA operational sequence and TEKNISA/NRCOMANDA reference across all station tickets for one order; IFOOD/NRCOMANDAEXT is displayed when present.
Sushi production tickets must receive a precomputed physical box label from the canonical packaging motor; the ticket renderer does not infer boxes.

Production-ticket visual contract prioritizes destination, TATA sequence, mounting box, quantity/item, observation, source identifiers and final check; structural customer/address/payment fields are not part of the ticket model.
A pure production-ticket preview/routing module was added with zero print/Odhen/service/cutover effects. Unproven routes block instead of falling back.
HOT/EBITEN/SHISO kitchen-demand summary was modeled with a truth boundary: before a production/low-off signal is proven, it may show SOLICITADO DESDE CORTE but must not claim PENDENTE.
Historical parser documentation was marked superseded where it claimed there was no production ticket split by station.

A dedicated source-only print-topology probe was added for CAIXA_MOOCA. It scans only known Odhen/Periféricos code roots, excludes Log/Logs/Temp/cache/node_modules, and targets ImpressaoDelivery, TXPRODCOMVEN, /print, arrFila, printCommands, LogIMP, formatTX and printer-routing tokens.

The print-topology probe static safety gate was independently replayed against the current branch content and PASSed: no HTTP, SQL, process start, credential-file reference, file mutation or Log-directory read capability was detected.
The stale claim that the real IMP log file existence was unproven was removed from durable state because metadata proof already established the file and later growth.

CAIXA_MOOCA directed source audit concluded LOCAL_PRINT_SOURCES_COMPLEMENTARY at code level: delivery print provides NRCOMANDA/NRCOMANDAEXT and delivery/item observations, while production print provides item-scoped TXPRODCOMVEN and printer destination; the common join is NRCOMANDA when production renders COMANDA.: DLV_<N>.
Production source path is proven capable of multiple copies per item (production, production 2, puxa); any join must deduplicate repeated production lines.
Odhen printer payload/log identity carries model + port, not the TATA physical praça name; praça requires an explicit mapping layer.

The broad topology probe was corrected after the real PC audit: v2 uses the actual C:\TEKNISA\odhen-perifericos and C:\TEKNISA\odhenPOS structure through an explicit file allowlist and no recursive/generic-token scan.
The corrected targeted topology probe static gate was independently replayed against current branch content and PASSed.

A per-printer IMP metadata-only monitor was added to observe only filename/length/timestamps for *_IMP_<modelo>_<porta>.txt; its static gate was independently replayed and PASSed with no file-content read or write capability.

A pure TATA sequence planner was added. It enforces one TATA sequence per TEKNISA order inside an explicit caller-provided scope, reuses the same sequence on replay/reprint, blocks sequence collisions, and does not define or persist the operational reset policy.
The TATA sequence planner deliberately leaves scope meaning, reset timing, width/range and persistence UNKNOWN until human-confirmed instead of hard-coding an invented daily policy.

A pure HOT/EBITEN/SHISO dependency engine was added. It accepts only exact normalized human-confirmed item rules and blocks any claim of a complete total unless both ruleset coverage and coverage proof are explicitly complete/human-confirmed.
The canonical kitchen dependency baseline is intentionally PARTIAL + UNPROVEN with zero rules, so no HOT/EBITEN/SHISO total can become operational by accident.

A pure Delivery+Production join was added. It requires a proven DLV_<NRCOMANDA> production join key, matching NRCOMANDA, exact accent/case/punctuation-normalized item name + quantity, and blocks ambiguous/missing matches rather than guessing.
The delivery-production join deduplicates identical TXPRODCOMVEN text across production/production2/puxa copies while preserving distinct printer keys.
A behavioral verifier was prepared for TATA sequence reuse/collision, kitchen dependency gates/arithmetic, duplicate-order aggregation, and conservative delivery-production joining.

A static production-parallel safety/truth gate was independently replayed against the current branch content and PASSed: the new pure modules contain no filesystem/network/print/SQL capability; the dependency baseline remains PARTIAL/UNPROVEN/empty.

A pre-existing TypeScript build blocker in passivePrintLog.ts was corrected by declaring orderObservationSectionStarted, and a pre-existing escaped-newline syntax error in tools/verificar_shadow_odhen_v132.js was corrected.
The kitchen dependency yield validator was hardened for strict TypeScript typing.
